cohort: Women admitted with twin pregnancy >28 weeks gestation at a tertiary care hospital in Karad, Maharashtra over a two-year period.
finding: Twin gestation is associated with increased risk of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, including a neonatal mortality rate of 3.34%, most commonly due to birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most frequent mode of delivery (62.04%).
